arguments.text: Implemented and locally verified evaluate(request, evidence, policy): filters by claim, withdrawal, verification policy, and exact required-condition values; reports sorted missing conditions; applies eligible-record supersession; compares canonical JSON values; distinguishes Boolean false as unsupported; preserves inputs; and uses caller arguments. report.json equals evaluation of current requests.json against current evidence.json and policy.json and conforms to OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json. No unresolved limits observed in the specified valid-JSON input domain.
